chunks: From him, from Ṣafwān and Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad, from one of the two عليهما السلام, who said:
The obligatory salat (prayer) is not valid inside the interior of the Kaʿbah.

key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Kaʿbah, the sacred House in Makkah
key_terms.الْمَكْتُوبَةِ: the obligatory, meaning the prescribed mandatory prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةُ: salat (prayer), the ritual prayer being discussed
key_terms.لَا تَصْلُحُ: is not valid or not proper in this legal context

ai.seo_question: Is obligatory salat (prayer) valid inside the Kaʿbah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the place of performing obligatory salat (prayer). It states that the prescribed obligatory prayer is not proper or valid when performed inside the Kaʿbah, making it relevant to rulings of salat and sacred space.
